scope: Retained desktop wallpaper pixels; native single-output integer scaling and sequential unprofiled VM measurements
source_commit_scope: Measurement ran from this clean source checkpoint. The implementation commit has identical desktop/framework runtime code; the later commit corrects only the native harness display mode.
architecture: Framework Resize events report logical dimensions and integer buffer scale; immutable ImageData retains a sufficient cover mip chain and preserves natural aspect independently of odd retained sizes
BackgroundTarget and AssetPort belong to client presentation outside the pure domain; NativeAssets prepares pixels on the appearance worker
Wallpaper selection owns one accepted refit plus the latest desired physical target; stale source/size results are rejected; resize never commits selection or colors
Last-good pixels remain visible and failed refits require explicit retry; decoding remains outside view/layout/paint

native.scope: Prepared single-output VM; software Vulkan; integer scales only

comparison.interpretation: Sequential runs on a shared host with matching detected display/workload/software-Vulkan metadata. Observed RSS includes mapped driver allocations; this is not isolated allocation attribution or a physical-GPU memory measurement. No CPU, startup or animation improvement is claimed.

deployment: Only the release desktop binary installed using verified upload, atomic rename and a private rollback copy. Actual running executable hash matched. Existing native greeter login reached the desktop; CLI, lock and login binaries were not changed. Builds and host GPU suites ran with the guest off and one Cargo job.
restoration: Native tests restored the original output and idle marker; immutable selected wallpaper and saved preferences were unchanged. The measurement restored the prior stay-awake marker. Only the Lucent guest is running at 3 GiB/four vCPUs.
limitations: 293.25 MiB mean process RSS remains above the 200 MiB target; fullscreen dock/widget buffers remain a separate cost
Source decoding and mip creation still use the configured 4096-pixel source envelope; transient old/new images, decoder scratch and allocator retention are not bounded by retained-pixel counters
Unused GPU textures remain eligible for the 64 MiB reuse cache; active textures, framebuffers and driver allocations are different scopes
One background surface, integer scaling only; independent per-monitor wallpapers, fractional scaling, hotplug and suspend/resume remain open
Native test exercises 1920x1080 physical pixels at scales 1 and 2, plus 1024x768 at scale 1; it does not establish larger-output or physical-GPU desktop behavior
Appearance worker panic/admission failure retains existing fatal supervised-reload policy; ordinary decode failures retain last-good pixels
Lock/login image preparation is unchanged; authentication build alignment and secure lock retesting remain open
Long-idle/fault/hardware frame-pacing evidence and the other acceptance groups remain incomplete; exact-head CI and review are tracked by PR #31
